name: localmcpbrower
description: Repo root entry points. The judge-layer commands live here (protected by .ankotti/evolve.json); the MCP server package is claude/.

scripts.eval: npm --prefix claude run build && node claude/eval/run.mjs
scripts.eval:smoke: npm --prefix claude run build && node claude/eval/smoke-sites.mjs
scripts.eval:baseline: npm --prefix claude run build && node claude/eval/run.mjs --update-baseline
scripts.test: npm --prefix claude run build && node --test claude/test/unit/
